What and why

The AI-apps layout now yields to the existing focused-window Back owner even when a mixed Chats/app desktop has no layout app-pane model. A live Reading list check was attributed to outside-click dismissal, but its outside-click assertion passed: the following Escape assertion failed. The shell consumed Escape as an AI-apps surface action without calling Browser's registered Back handler. Direct app Back handled the menu correctly.

Recording cancellation and shared transient-owner ordering stay first. The existing app Back implementation and app-root/preview/workflow policy remain unchanged; a modeled app pane still receives just one Back callback per press. No Reading list state, skins, app assets, phone native code or authentication changes.

Reuse:

  • Back order: EXTEND WosSkinHost layout surface callback (layouts/ai-apps/desktop.js), yielding an iframe it does not own to the existing desktop fallback.
  • Hosted app Back: REUSE WizAppServices.back through the existing desktop escStep; no new handler protocol or overlay implementation.

Visual: no drawn/animated changes. Private in-shell candidate screenshot inspected in Nebula after strict open/outside-close/reopen/Escape-close assertions. Grove/phone remain in the restaged live acceptance job; an earlier skin-switch coordinate probe was rejected because it never opened the menu.

Verified

  • nice -n 19 node --test tests/back-owners.test.mjs: new focused-frame cases fail on the exact live baseline, pass after the fix.
  • nice -n 19 node --test tests/back-owners.test.mjs tests/desktop-escape-back.test.mjs tests/desktop-keys-layout.test.mjs: PASS.
  • nice -n 19 python3 tools/build-offline-session.py --check: PASS (layout surface callback is not in standalone-shell dependency closure).
  • Focused manual CDP check, using an isolated context in an existing Chromium, all writes/private chat reads denied: live baseline leaves the menu open after Escape (esc:surface); the candidate layout callback closes it on the same event in Nebula. Outside click already closes it on both baseline and candidate. Candidate bytes were intercepted only for this isolated proof; this is not a live-deployment claim.
  • git diff --check: PASS.

Not checked

Complete exact-head checks are delegated to this PR's normal CI. Full read-only live desktop/phone screenshot acceptance follows promotion. No physical phone claim.

Links

Live-preserving fix based on the currently served developer release; no reset to main and no owner data writes.
